title: Lock Left Unsecured Overnight
dataSources: Object detections (`frigate:event`), camera health (`camera:health`), alarm state changes (`alarm:event`), smart-lock access (`lock:access`), plate and gate events (`gate:event`), and doorbell delivery telemetry (`doorbell:event`).
app: Home-security telemetry from Frigate and Blue Iris detections, camera health feeds, smart locks, alarm panels, doorbells, and gate sensors streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and Home Assistant integrations.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lock:access
| bin _time span=1d
| stats latest(locked) as locked by door _time
| where locked=0
description: Shows doors whose last nightly lock state was still unlocked so you can tighten the overnight routine.
value: A simple overnight lock audit catches forgotten doors without needing full intrusion logic or complex automation.
implementation: Ingest smart-lock state changes and review the last recorded lock status for each door after the evening window.
visualization: Daily table of doors left unlocked overnight.
grandmaExplanation: It spots which doors ended the night unlocked, so you can close an easy security gap.
